options.name: asp_group
options.description: Specifies the name of the auxiliary storage pool (ASP) group to set for the current thread. The ASP group name is the name of the primary ASP device within the ASP group.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: parameters
options.description: The parameters that RUNSQLSTM command will take. All other parameters need to be specified here. The default values of parameters for RUNSQLSTM will be taken if not specified. Only works for sql script.

options.name: severity_level
options.description: When run sql script, specifies whether the processing is successful, based on the severity of the messages generated by the processing of the SQL statements. If errors that are greater than the value specified for this parameter occur during processing, no more statements are run and the statements are rolled back if they are running under commitmentcontrol. Only works for sql script.

options.name: src
options.description: Script file path on the remote ibm i node. The path can be absolute or relative.

options.name: type
options.description: Specify the script file type. Only support C(CL) or C(SQL) script by now.
